How to Ask a Girl to Be Your Girlfriend: In Person, by Text or Long Distance

Learn how to ask a girl to be your girlfriend with clear, considerate words—in person, over text or across distance—and how to respect her answer.

If you are thinking about how to ask a girl to be your girlfriend, aim for clarity and kindness rather than a perfect line. The best approach makes your feelings understandable, gives her space to share hers and avoids turning the moment into a test.

Love & Romance8 min readUpdated 7 November 2026
Written by RA FahimWishly Guide Editorial

Make sure you understand what you are asking

Before asking, reflect on what being together means to you. Are you asking to date exclusively, to use the word girlfriend, or to begin a committed relationship? People can use relationship labels differently, so be prepared to discuss expectations rather than assume you both mean exactly the same thing.

Notice whether you have both shown interest and had conversations about dating. Do not treat friendliness as proof of romantic interest. If you are unsure, a calm conversation about how each of you sees the connection may be more useful than planning a surprise.

How to ask in person

Choose a comfortable moment when you can talk without interruption. You might say: “I really enjoy spending time with you, and I would like to make this relationship official. Would you like to be my girlfriend?” This is direct, warm and gives her a clear question to answer.

You can add a personal detail about what you appreciate, but keep the focus on the conversation. Avoid asking in front of a crowd unless you already know she would enjoy that. A private setting makes it easier for either person to speak honestly.

How to ask over text

Text can be a good option when it is how you normally communicate or when distance makes meeting difficult. Be specific instead of sending a vague hint. For example: “I have really liked getting to know you. I would like us to be exclusive and call each other partners. How would that feel to you?”

Do not send repeated messages demanding an answer. Give her time to think and respond. If the conversation becomes complicated or either person feels misunderstood, suggest a call rather than trying to solve every feeling through a long chain of texts.

How to ask in a long-distance relationship

If you are far apart, arrange a video or voice call at a time that works for both of you. You could send a small digital letter or a personal webpage first, then talk about what a relationship would look like across distance: communication, visits, boundaries and expectations.

A surprise page made with Wishly can introduce your message, but the relationship question should still be a real conversation. Do not assume a romantic template replaces talking about time zones, travel, exclusivity or what each person wants.

Respect every possible answer

A yes is a beginning, not a complete agreement about every future detail. Talk together about what the relationship means. If she says no or is not ready, thank her for being honest and do not try to negotiate her feelings.

You can feel disappointed and still respond respectfully. A healthy relationship starts with mutual interest, not persistence after someone has declined.

Frequently asked questions

Should I ask a girl to be my girlfriend over text?

Text is fine when it suits your communication style or circumstances. Be clear, considerate and willing to continue the conversation by voice or in person.

What should I say when asking her to be my girlfriend?

Say what you enjoy about the connection, explain what you would like and ask a direct question. Use words that sound natural to you.

What if she says she is not ready?

Respect the answer. Ask whether she wants to discuss expectations, but do not pressure her to change her mind.
